en: Yay!
Yea?
Yep.
Yes.
Yes?

How dare you ask me for training, maggot? What were you hoping for, you slack-jawed yokel, a lecture on the proper uses of silverleaf? Out! You're lucky I don't thrash you senseless for wasting my time.

You honor me with your presence, $r. Alas, it is too late for me. I pass from this world soon, but... I know so much. So much is in this head of mine. So much that could help this world fend off the beasts of this citadel of depravity.$B$BPerhaps if you are a master of a trade... Yes, perhaps you would take the knowledge I hold and use it to save this world.
Go to the Valley of Strength and look for the Bank of Orgrimmar to the south of the Sky Tower.
All hail $n, a $c of worth!

<Goretooth spits.>$B$BI am a warrior of the Horde, $n. It fills me with rage to know that our enemies sit in a fortress, less than a day's ride from Kargath, plotting against us.$B$BHow I long to break free from the bonds of duty and destroy them all in the name of the Warchief.$B$BAlas, we all have roles we must fulfill.
Get away from here, $c, or they'll put you in chains as well.
Never had much use for a bow, but these rifles the goblins make are very handy when hunting. Still can't get used to the smell though.

Tailoring you say?  Hmmm.  Ah yes, of course.  You'll need to head to Thunder Bluff, up north.  Take the path out of the village to get there.  When you arrive at the base of the bluffs ride the elevator to the top of the rise and speak with one of the Bluffwatchers.
All those official types reside in Ironforge.  Ye'll be wanting to check out the Ironforge Visitor's Center for guild creation papers.
The Iceblood Tower protects the Iceblood Garrison from the southeast.$B$Bis controlled by neither side.
Proudtusk!
Stand firm, brothers.  And don't worry!  Size is on our side!
We mustn't anger the Master. His is a wrath that is cruel beyond measure.
Alexstrasza is  my answer.
Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

Enjoying the festival, $c?$b$bWhile the Flamekeeper tends to the fires of the present, I am more of a historian, keeping close the festivals past. I'm also, of course, documenting this year's festivities. Things are going well thus far, don't you think?$b$bYou know, $n, there is power inherent in all festival fires burning throughout the holiday. We're taking care of ours, but I'm certain there are sacred flames burning deep within our enemy's cities...
Impossible!
Impossible.
I would like to train further in the ways of the Light.
I shall find you mortals!  You shall pay for destroying the Ash'ari Crystals!
No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!
Good work, soldier. Now we light the fires and spite their ire!
Some of you have not fought in battles. Peace has been with us for many years. Many years we sat idle but many years we battled.
The battle is won! Watch as they flee to the safety of their precious temple. Soon all will be razed... Their leaders destroyed!
With the Earth Mother's blessing, we shall begin.
Even in peace there is still war, and many clans still fight beneath the banner of the Warchief. Are you here to add your clan to those that fight for Orgrimmar?
That's the second building on the right in the Valley of Strength north of the main city entrance.  Speak to Innkeeper Gryshka.

The Argent Dawn might be impotent idealists but their delusional leader knows that they are outmatched. I have been sent here as an emissary of the Scarlet Crusade. An ambassador, if you will... It is doubtful that we could even dent the armies of Kel'Thuzad - united or not - but we might be able to contain them long enough for some sort of miracle to happen.$B$BAs for me? I'll die in battle...$B$B<Marjhan shrugs.>
%s pokes the small toad.
Help! Guards! It's going to step on me!
I am he that watches they. I am the fist of retribution. That which does quell the recalcitrant. Dare you defy the Warchief? Dare you face my merciless judgement?
Noma should have dinner ready soon. Might as well head in.
Did you bring your text books?  Can I look on with you?
Is it true that the paladins train here?
Why do you say that this is a coincidence, Rabine?
If I am excused, then I'd like to check on Quinn...
It's quiet... Too quiet...
Zaldimar could probably teach you some new spells.  He has recently taken a liking to staying at the Lion's Pride Inn, you might want to check one of the rooms and see if he's in.
Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.
%s begins to work...
Don't let them catch you!
Can't help you. You know more about potions than I do. Besides, I have pots to watch. Talk to Yelmak over there. He knows a lot about potions.
